assumptions: A Flipkart-size store: about 2,000 orders a minute on an average day (yearly GMV of ₹1.75–2.1 lakh crore ÷ ₹1,847 per order ÷ 525,600 minutes), each worth ₹1,847 on average
Failed share of orders equals the alert's 5xx rate (38%)
Every failed order counts as revenue at risk; some customers retry later, so the money actually lost is lower
A typical manual fix for this kind of incident takes about 80 minutes with 3 engineers paged (our estimate)
An engineer costs about ₹1,070 an hour: the median Bengaluru SRE pay of ₹20.5 lakh a year over about 1,920 working hours (salary only; benefits and tools would add more)
